name: Carlos Sigel
source:
Star Sign: Aquarius
Elemental Attribute: Water
Special Attribute: Create 2
Starting Spells: Fire 5/Holy 6/Healing 3/Call 4
Symbol: Twin rings in the shape of a skull and angel (Level 4)

He's one class above Yume in the Academy.
It's rumored that he's a delinquent, but it's also rumored that he's smarter than both Akito and Yuri.
He runs a hidden magic lab in the school that sells prohibited items.
A blunt guy with a bad mouth, but he has a nice side where he lets low grade familiars stay in the lab.
